::: {#def-datasheet}

#### Datasheet

A **datasheet** for a data set is a document that answers questions about seven topics [@gebru2021datasheets, section 3]:

- why the data set was made;
- what it holds;
- how it was collected;
- how it was cleaned and labelled;
- what it should and should not be used for;
- how it is distributed;
- who maintains it.

:::
